entities.summary: Zarphatic, also called Judeo-French or Western Loez, is a language that was spoken by the French Jews of northern France and in parts of western Germany, such as Mainz, Frankfurt am Main and Aix-la-Chapelle. It was also spoken by French Jews who moved to Norman England. Some have conjectured that the language influenced the development of Yiddish.
